children.text: Hello, my name is Mike and today is my 14th birthday.
children.cn: 你好，我叫迈克，今天是我的14岁生日。
children.statement: 开门见山点明自己的身份及14岁生日主题。
children.explanation: 明确交代了生日背景信息。

children.text: My family have a wonderful and big dinner at noon.
children.cn: 我和我的家人们在中午吃了一顿丰盛的大餐。
children.notes: at noon = 在中午；wonderful = 极好的
children.statement: 本句引出提示 (1) 的生日午餐环节。
children.explanation: 交代午餐时间和家庭成员共聚一堂的场景。

children.text: We have delicious hamburgers, pizzas and lots of fresh fruit.
children.cn: 我们吃了美味的汉堡包、披萨和大量新鲜水果。
children.notes: lots of = 许多；fresh fruit = 新鲜水果
children.statement: 详细列举了提示 (1) 所要求的具体食物。
children.explanation: 涵盖了汉堡、披萨、水果等食物要点。

children.text: I also drink some sweet orange juice and cold cola.
children.cn: 我还喝了一些甜橙汁和冰可乐。
children.notes: orange juice = 橙汁；cold cola = 冰可乐
children.statement: 详细列举了提示 (1) 所要求的具体饮品。
children.explanation: 补充了饮品细节，符合题意。
children.keywords: drink, sweet orange juice, cold cola

children.text: My father buys a cool toy car for me, and my mother gives me a pair of shoes.
children.cn: 爸爸给我买了一辆酷炫的玩具车，妈妈送给我一双鞋子。
children.notes: buy sth. for sb. = 给某人买某物；a pair of shoes = 一双鞋子
children.statement: 完整回答了提示 (2) “What do you get on your birthday?”。
children.explanation: 详述父母赠送的生日礼物。
children.keywords: father buys toy car, mother gives shoes

children.text: After lunch, I play basketball with my good friends in the park.
children.cn: 午饭后，我和好朋友们在公园里打篮球。
children.notes: after lunch = 午饭后；play basketball with = 和……打篮球
children.statement: 完整回答了提示 (3) “What do you do after lunch...”。
children.explanation: 交代午后进行的有意义的体育活动。
children.keywords: After lunch, play basketball, good friends

children.text: We have a great time and this is really a happy day.
children.cn: 我们玩得很开心，这真是一个快乐的日子。
children.notes: have a great time = 玩得开心；happy day = 快乐的一天
children.statement: 文末总结情感体验，圆满收尾。
children.explanation: 升华文章主旨，结构完整。
children.keywords: have a great time, happy day

children.text: Hello, everyone! My name is Mike, and today marks a memorable milestone—my 14th birthday.
children.cn: 大家好！我叫迈克，今天标志着一个难忘的里程碑——我的14岁生日。
children.notes: marks a milestone = 标志着一个里程碑；memorable = 难忘的
children.statement: “marks a memorable milestone” 高级修辞点题。
children.explanation: 比简单的 today is... 更加生动形象。

children.text: At noon, my whole family gathered around the dining table to enjoy an exceptionally sumptuous feast.
children.cn: 中午，我们全家围坐在餐桌旁享用了一顿格外丰盛的大餐。
children.notes: gather around = 聚集在……周围；exceptionally sumptuous feast = 格外丰盛的盛宴
children.statement: “to enjoy...” 动词不定式作目的状语。
children.explanation: sumptuous feast 高级词汇描绘丰盛午餐。

children.text: We relished homemade crispy hamburgers, cheesy pizzas, colorful fruit salads, alongside chilled refreshing beverages.
children.cn: 我们品尝了自制的香脆汉堡、芝士披萨、色彩缤纷的水果沙拉，以及冰爽怡人的饮品。
children.notes: relish = 尽情品味；crispy = 酥脆的；alongside = 伴随，还有
children.statement: 多种形容词修饰使食物与饮品的描写更加诱人。
children.explanation: 生动具体地覆盖提示 (1) 的所有食物饮品要点。
children.keywords: relished hamburgers, cheesy pizzas, fruit salads, chilled beverages

children.text: To my pleasant surprise, my father presented me with a high-tech remote control car, while my mother gifted me stylish running shoes.
children.cn: 令我惊喜的是，父亲送给我一辆高科技遥控车，而母亲则送给我一双时尚的跑鞋。
children.notes: To one's pleasant surprise = 令某人惊喜的是；present sb. with sth. = 赠送某人某物；while 表对比
children.statement: “while” 连词连接父母双方的礼物对比介绍。
children.explanation: 礼貌高级地回答了提示 (2) 的礼物要点。
children.keywords: pleasant surprise, father presented car, mother gifted shoes

children.text: Filled with immense excitement after lunch, I met up with my buddies on the sports field for a thrilling basketball match.
children.cn: 午饭后怀着无比兴奋的心情，我和同伴们在运动场上汇合，进行了一场激动人心的篮球比赛。
children.notes: Filled with excitement = 过去分词短语作状语；thrilling match = 激动人心的比赛
children.statement: “Filled with immense excitement” 过去分词短语作伴随状语。
children.explanation: 极富感染力地呈现午后体育活动。
children.keywords: Filled with excitement, met up buddies, thrilling basketball match

children.text: Surrounded by deep familial love and sincere friendships, this special birthday will remain etched in my memory forever.
children.cn: 沉浸在深厚的亲情和真挚的友情中，这个特别的生日将永远铭刻在我的记忆之中。
children.notes: Surrounded by... = 过去分词短语作状语；remain etched in my memory = 永远铭刻在记忆中
children.statement: 分词短语置于句首，文末升华主题。
children.explanation: 句意优美，思想深刻，完美点睛全篇。
children.keywords: familial love, sincere friendships, etched in memory
